facts.text: RosSocialEnv is a PettingZoo ParallelEnv for multi-agent social navigation, not a ROS transport class.
The constructor's num_agents default is (3, 5); possible_agents is player_<index> for the maximum of that range.
The constructor builds possible_agents and curr_num_agents from num_agents.
Every possible agent's action space is spaces.Discrete(2).
Every possible agent's observation space is Box(low=-9999, high=9999, shape=(len(observer),)).
observation_space(agent) and action_space(agent) return the entries of those per-agent maps.
The constructor starts a ROS node and a roslaunch parent for launch_config, then creates the UTMRS service client and the SocialPips service proxy.
UTMRS waits for and proxies the utmrsStepper and utmrsReset services.

reset(seed=None, return_info=True, options=None) resets the scenario, observer and rewarder, calls the simulator reset and a default step, and returns a dict of per-agent observations and a dict of infos.
step(action_dict) copies each agent's discrete action into the action array sent to the UTMRS step together with x/y/angle velocity arrays and max speeds.
step returns per-agent observation, reward, termination, truncation and info dicts.
RosSocialEnv.seed(seed=None) is a no-op and close() is a no-op.
RosSocialEnv.close does not shut down the launched simulator.
ManualZoneEnv is a RosSocialEnv subclass and overrides sim_step to use the manual-zone response type.
ManualZoneEnv.sim_step calls the UTMRS step and converts it with its own response type.
The config runner wraps the environment with SuperSuit's pettingzoo_env_to_vec_env_v1 and concat_vec_envs_v1 before training.
The README describes the project as a multi-agent simulator for real world social navigation.

determinism.notes: the fake reseeds Python's random.Random on reset(seed); upstream seed() is a no-op and the simulator's random stream is external, so a seed does not reproduce an upstream trajectory

gaps: the fake is pure Python: it runs no ROS node, no roslaunch, no UTMRS/pedsim process, no physics, no human agents and no observer or rewarder

the upstream action interface is PettingZoo's per-agent action_space(agent) map; the shared adapter exposes one joint gymnasium Dict whose members copy the sourced Discrete(2) bounds, and the step input therefore requires every agent key at once
the upstream observation width is len(observer), a runtime configuration; the fake returns a shorter placeholder vector of four values per agent and models no observation semantics
upstream step returns per-agent reward, termination and truncation dicts; the bridge's scalar fields sum native rewards and complete only when all episode agents finish; per-agent maps stay in info
the fake fixes the number of agents at a placeholder five, the maximum of the upstream constructor default (3, 5); num_agents is a deployment configuration
reset and step state, rewards and observations are placeholder test data, not the simulator's scenario generation or dynamics
the clone declares no fixed simulation timestep; the UTMRS simulator clock is external, so timestep_ms is 0 and the fake has no wall-clock pacing
snapshot and restore are not offered: the upstream class exposes no get_state/set_state pair
upstream seed() is a no-op; only the fake's Python generator is reseeded
upstream close() is a no-op and does not stop the launched simulator; the fake has no external process to stop
no hardware is modelled or contacted
